<subject>Component Supply 2024</subject>
<body>
My name is Andrea Reeves and I am the Supplier Quality Coordinator for the Bristol unit this year. I understand that you oversaw supplier quality for your production line last year. I do not yet have confirmation on who is managing supplier quality for your line this year. Could you please reply to this email to confirm if you are still the lead for supplier quality? If not, would you kindly provide the name of the current quality lead (and specify the production line number(s) in your reply)? I have already sent three emails to other line managers today and would like to get this information to your line’s quality manager as soon as possible. Thanks very much for your help!
</body>
